description: This pie chart illustrates a taxonomy of medical ethics, representing the distribution of 26 categories clustered from 256 detailed principles, in relation to four pillar principles in medicine. The chart consists of 26 slices, arranged concentrically with an inner circle representing the four pillar principles and a larger, outer circle for the 26 categories. The four inner slices are labeled “Beneficence” (blue), “Non-Maleficence” (purple), “Autonomy” (orange), and “Justice” (red). The outer circle includes categories such as “Continual Learning” (blue), “Provide Assistance in Emergency” (purple), “Respect and Cooperate with Colleagues” (green), and “Ethical research” (light blue), among others, with each labeled along its arc. Percentage labels are not displayed within the slices, and while slice sizes vary, the outer segments appear generally similar in proportion, with no segments visually emphasized through explosion or color variation beyond the distinctions between the four main principles. A legend is not present, however, the color coding seems to partially align with the four inner pillar categories.
